<thought>Only the regular 1 Da spaced isotopic envelope with gradually decreasing intensities is evident, which is characteristic of the natural ^13C/^12C distribution. No other distinct patterns (e.g., the 2 Da 1:1 pattern of Br or the 3:1 pattern of Cl) are visible, so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
